title: BizFlood Premium Accounting Schedule — Fees, Inspection Threshold and Payment Plans
content:
BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) carry an annual policy fee, which is fully earned; a fee per location for the underwriting inspection at new business; a location value above which that inspection is required before binding; and the payment plans available, with the quarterly down payment and the fee on each installment after the first. All amounts are in USD.

## Fees and inspection threshold

| Tier | Annual policy fee (fully earned) | Inspection fee per location | Inspection required for a location valued above |
|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 250 | 175 | 2500000 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 250 | 175 | 2500000 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 250 | 175 | 2500000 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 250 | 175 | 2500000 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 250 | 175 | 2500000 |
| BizFlood Large Property | 250 | 175 | 0 |

On BizFlood Large Property the inspection threshold is 0, so every location with any value is above it.

## Payment plans

| Tier | Plans available | Quarterly down payment (percent) | Fee per installment after the first |
|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | Annual, Quarterly | 40 | 15 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | Annual, Quarterly | 40 | 15 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | Annual, Quarterly | 40 | 15 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | Annual, Quarterly | 40 | 15 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | Annual, Quarterly | 40 | 15 |
| BizFlood Large Property | Annual only | 40 | 15 |

BizFlood Large Property is written on the annual plan only; the quarterly figures shown against it have no plan to apply to.

## Threshold cases (hypothetical location values)

| Tier | Location value | Above the threshold? |
|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 2,500,000 | No — equal to 2500000 is not above it |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 2,500,001 | Yes |
| BizFlood Large Property | 50,000 | Yes — above 0 |
